case_number: Criminal Appeal No. of 2024 (@ SLP (Crl.) No. 3995 of 2022)
summary: The appeal challenges the High Court's order quashing FIR No.0080/2020 against accused No.6 (husband of petitioner) but dismissing the quashment plea for accused No.5 (petitioner). The petitioner, related only as wife of cousin brother of complainant's son-in-law, alleged over-implication in a matrimonial dispute with no specific allegations against her. The Supreme Court considered whether her inclusion was due to mala fide or exaggerated complaints common in matrimonial cases. Relying on precedents like Preeti Gupta and Geeta Mehrotra, it emphasized caution in implicating distant relatives living in different cities. The High Court failed to properly analyze the lack of specific allegations against her, warranting quashment.
legal_provisions_cited: Preeti Gupta & Anr. v. State of Jharkhand & Anr. (2010) 7 SCC 667
Geeta Mehrotra and Anr. v. State of U.P. and Anr. (2012) 10 SCC 741
Kahkashan Kausar @ Sonam and Others v. State of Bihar & Ors. (2022) 6 SCC 599
final_judgment: The appeal is allowed; the FIR and all further proceedings against accused No.5 (Payal Sharma) are quashed.
